_readme: Single source of truth for image metadata. Each key maps to alt text + placeholder flag. When you drop a real photo at the file path AND set placeholder:false, the 'STOCK · REPLACE' badge disappears automatically. Width/height help prevent CLS for SVG placeholders only — raster photos use intrinsic dimensions.
